scripts.text: ^ff0000It seems that the type or weight of the item you have is too much. Please organize your inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000您携带的物品种类过多或负重过高，请先整理物品栏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
If you bring automatic equipment and reinforcement modules, we can enchant the appropriate module on the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
带来全自动装备和强化模组，就能将对应的模组效果附加到装备上。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
This is done according to the specification module, so the equipment will not be destroyed. However, the number of upgrades can vary depending on the module.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
强化使用标准规格的模组，因此装备不会损坏。
不过，不同模组的强化次数上限也不同。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Then please visit again when you need help~
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
那么，需要帮助时请再来找我哦~

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
If you bring automatic equipment and reinforcement modules, we can enchant the appropriate module on the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
带来全自动装备和强化模组，就能将对应的模组效果附加到装备上。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
{0}.
Please select the grade of module that you want to use.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
{0}。
请选择要使用的模组等级。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
You must possess a module in your inventory that matches the efficacy to proceed with the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
需要在物品栏中持有效果对应的模组，才能继续强化。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Please make sure you have equipped the proper automatic equipment that you want to enhance.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
请确保您已装备想要强化的全自动装备。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
This automatic equipment is already at its maximum capacity.
Please try another automatic equipment.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
这件全自动装备已达到最大强化等级。
请尝试其他全自动装备。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
You can not enchant this module to this automatic equipment.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
这件全自动装备无法使用此模组附魔。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
This automatic equipment has already maximized the enhancement from this module.
Please try another module.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
这件全自动装备已达到此模组的强化次数上限。
请使用其他模组。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Are you sure you want to enchance your ^FF0000{0}^000000 with ^0000CD{1}^000000? This process cannot be reversed.
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
您确定要为^FF0000{0}^000000使用^0000CD{1}^000000进行强化吗？
此操作无法撤销。

scripts.text:
[Lisa]
Woaaaah~ I can feel the power of your automatic equipment already~!
scripts.translation:
[丽莎]
哇啊~已经能感受到您全自动装备的力量了~！

scripts.text:
[Cube Lane]
We are offering reinforcement cubes that will refine your ^0000CD+4^000000 Illusion and Automatic Equipment to ^FF0000+7^000000 in an instant!
Varmundt is no doubt the best man in the world!
scripts.translation:
[方块巷]
我们提供强化立方体，能瞬间将^0000CD+4^000000的幻象和全自动装备精炼到^FF0000+7^000000！
瓦尔蒙特果然是世上最棒的人！

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
The bag is full. Please check the weight and number of items in your possession before talking again.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
背包已满。请检查您持有的物品重量和数量后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
We accept Barmeal Tickets for upgrading your Illusion Equipment into Automatic Requipments.
What would you like to exchange?
scripts.translation:
[延青]
支付霸肋门德餐券，就能把幻象装备升级为全自动装备。
您想兑换什么？

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
You can exchange your ^0000CD+9 Illusion Armor, Engine, or Leg and 900 Barmeal Tickets^000000 to ^FF0000Automatic Armor, Engine, or Leg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
用^0000CD+9的幻象机甲、推进翼或战靴，加上900张霸肋门德餐券^000000，就能兑换对应的^FF0000全自动机甲、推进翼或战靴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
The ^FF0000Automatic Accessories^000000 can be exchanged for ^0000CDIllusion Accessories and 1500 Barmeal Tickets^000000.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
想兑换^FF0000全自动饰品^000000，需要^0000CD幻象饰品和1500张霸肋门德餐券^000000。

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
The equipment you want to exchange must be in your inventory and talk to me.
^FF0000Bring only one equipment that you want to exchange and proceed.^000000
scripts.translation:
[延青]
请把要兑换的装备放在物品栏里，再来找我。
^FF0000每次请只携带一件要兑换的装备。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
Have a nice day, dear guest~
scripts.translation:
[延青]
祝您有美好的一天，亲爱的客人~

scripts.text:
[Yeoncheong]
^FF0000Bring only one equipment that you want to exchange and proceed.^000000
If there are multiple equipments in your inventory, it will be exchanged randomly if it meets the condition.
scripts.translation:
[延青]
^FF0000每次请只携带一件要兑换的装备。^000000
如果物品栏里有多件符合条件的装备，将随机选取一件进行兑换。

scripts.text:
[Yecheon]
The bag is full. Please check the weight and number of items in your possession before talking again.
scripts.translation:
[礼泉]
背包已满。请检查您持有的物品重量和数量后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Yecheon]
I can provide you an Automatic Module, Physical Automatic Improvement Device, and Magical Automatic Improvement Device. It will help you the improve abilites of your automatic equipments.
scripts.translation:
[礼泉]
我可以为您提供全自动模组、物理全自动改良装置和魔法全自动改良装置。它们将帮助您提升全自动装备的能力。
获取物理全自动改良装置
获取魔法全自动改良装置

scripts.text:
[Yecheon]
You can get an ^FF0000automatic module^000000 for ^0000CD90 Barmeal Tickets^000000. I will give you a random automatic module excluding the epic grade modules.
scripts.translation:
[礼泉]

模组随机发放，不包括史诗级模组。

scripts.text:
[Yecheon]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Yecheon]
Then, combat-specialized guest, do safely improve your abilities.
scripts.translation:

那么，擅长战斗的客人，祝您顺利提升实力。
